definitions.explanation: shiitake mushrooms that have been dried for preservation, with intensified umami flavor

examples.japanese: {干|ほ}し{椎茸|しいたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: Rehydrate the dried shiitake in water.

examples.japanese: {干|ほ}し{椎茸|しいたけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戻|もど}し{汁|じる}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The liquid from rehydrating dried shiitake can be used as broth.

examples.japanese: {干|ほ}し{椎茸|しいたけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凝縮|ぎょうしゅく}→凝縮：17584_gyoushuku⟧⟦されていて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Dried shiitake has concentrated umami and deepens the flavor of dishes.

notes:
{干|ほ}し{椎茸|しいたけ} is an essential ingredient in Japanese cuisine, valued for its intense umami flavor.

WRITING:
- {干|ほ}し (dried)
- {椎茸|しいたけ} (shiitake mushroom)

PREPARATION:
- Must be rehydrated (⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧) before cooking
- Cold water produces better flavor (8+ hours)
- Hot water is faster but less flavorful

COOKING USES:
- {戻|もど}し{汁|じる} (soaking liquid) is used as flavorful broth
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered dishes)
- ⟦{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}→炊き込みご飯：05883_takikomigohan⟧ (mixed rice)
- ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (soup stock)

UMAMI:
- Drying process intensifies ⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧ (umami)
- Contains {グアニル酸|ぐあにるさん} (guanylic acid)

GRADES:
- {冬菇|どんこ} (thick, high-grade)
- {香信|こうしん} (thinner, everyday grade)

STORAGE:
- Keep in cool, dry place
- Can last for years if stored properly
